spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sewn, woven.
E.
ऊय to sew, affix क्त.
ind.
A particle of,
1 doubt, (what!)
2 of interrogation^1, (what, how?)
3 Of connection, (also, and);
4 of deliberation, (either, or.)
5 It is also an expletive.
E.
ऊङ to sound, क्त aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Wet, moistened.
E.
उन्द to wet, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Woven.
E.
वेञ् to weave, affix क्त.

m. (-थ्यः)
The name of a Muni, son of AṄGIRAS.

m. (-जः)
A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of the planet Jupiter.
E.
उतथ्य and अनुज younger born; the younger brother of UTATHYA.

m. (-न्मा)
VṚHASPATI: see the preceding.

ind.
A particle implying,
1 deliberation, (either, or);
2 asking, (how, what?)
E.
उत् and आहो meaning as before.

ind.
A particle of doubt or deliberation.

mn. (-सः)
1 An earring.
2 A crest.
E.
उत् much, and तसि a Sautra root, to ornament, affix अच्.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Burnt, seared.
2 Bathed, washed.
3 Anxious, excited.
n. (-प्तं)
Dried flesh.
E.
उत् much, or in the last sense priv. and तप्त heated.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Chief, principal, first, best.
2 Greatest, highest.
m. (-मः)
1 The third Menu, son of

PRIYAVRATA.
2

The best kind of lover or hero.
f. (-मा)
1 An excellent woman: one who is handsome, healthy, and affectionate.
2 A plant. (Asclepias rosea.)
E.
उत् much, तम to desire, affix अच्.

m. (-षः)
1 The first person, (in grammer.)
2 An excellent man.
E.
उत्तम and पुरुष man.

f. (-नी)
A plant, (Asclepias rosea, Rox.) see टुन्धिका.
E.
उत्तम best, फल fruit, इनि affix, and ङीप् fem. do.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
A creditor.
E.
उत्तम chief, and ऋण a debt.

m. (-कः)
A creditor.
E.
उत्तम, ऋण a debt, and ठक् aff.

m. (-र्णी)
A creditor.
E.
उत्तम, ऋण a debt, इनि aff.

m. (-भः)
Great profit, a double return.
E.
उत्तम and लाभ gain.

m. (-हः)
Intriguing with another man's wife, addressing her privately, casting amorous looks, &c.

n. (-सं)
1 The highest of the three fixed mulcts or fines; a fine of 1,000 or of 80,000

Paṇas.
2

Capital punishment, branding, banishment, confiscation, mutilation and death.
E.
उत्तम the best or greatest, साहस infliction.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The head.
E.
उत्तम chief, and अङ्ग member.

n. (-र्द्ध्यं)
The best half.
E.
उत्तम, अर्द्ध half, and यत् aff.

m. (-हः)
A fine day, a lucky day.
E.
उत्तम best, अहन a day, ट aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Best, good.
E.
उत्तम and उपपद secondary term, to whom or what the best term is applicable.

m. (-जाः)
A proper name, one of the warriors of the Mahābhārata.
E.
उत्तम and ओजस् strength.

n. (-नं)
1 Upholding, supporting, staying.
2 Stopping, arresting.
E.
उद् before ष्टभि to stop, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Upheld, supported.
2 Stopped, arrested.
3 Erect, (as the hair of the head,) standing on end.
E.
उत् before ष्टभि to stop, affix क्त.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Superior, high, lofty.
2

Northern.
3

Best, excellent.
4 (In composition) Fit, appertaining to.
5 Subsequent, posterior.
n. (-रं)
1 An answer, a reply.
2 (In law) A defence, a rejoinder.
3 A consequence, a result.
4 Remainder, difference, (in arithmetic.)
m. (-रः)
The son of VIRĀṬA.
f. (-रा)
1 The wife of ABHIMANYU, the son of

ARJUNA.
2

The north.
E.
उत् above, and तर from तृ to pass, affix अप्.

ind.
North, northerly, northward.
E.
उत्तर and आच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Excellent, pre-eminent.
m. (-रः)
1

Vomiting.
2

Passing away, instability.
3 Ejecting, getting rid. of.
E.
उत् above, and तार who passes, from तृ and घञ् aff.

m. (-लः)
Future time.
2 Time reckoned from full moon to full moon.
E.
उत्तर subsequent, काल time.

mn. (-रुः-रु)
Uttarakuru, the country about the north pole.
E.
उत्तर northern, and कुरु the northern part of the globe.

f. (-ला)
The city Ayodhyā, the modern Oude.
E.
उत्तर north, कोशला a district so called.

f. (-या)
Obsequial ceremonies.
E.
उत्तर last, क्रिया rite.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Flooded, inundated, washed under by waves.
n. (-ङ्गं)
A wooden arch surmounting the door frame.
E.
उत्तर above, ग what goes, affix खश्; or उत् and तरङ्ग a wave.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born subsequently or afterwards, posterity.
E.
उत्तर and ज born.

f. (-ज्या)
The versed sine of an arc.
E.
उत्तर and ज्या an arc.

n. (-णं)
1 Crossing, rivers, &c.
2 Coming forth or out of, (especially water,) landing.
E.
उत् over, तरण passing.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
1 Crossing, going over.
2 Coming out of (water.)
E.
उत् before तृ to cross, शतृ aff.

ind.
Northward.
E.
उत्तर and आति aff.

ind.
1

Northward.
2

Afterwards.
3

Behind.
E.
उत्तर and अतसुच् aff.

ind.
1 After, subsequent.
2 Northward.
E.
उत्तर and त्रल् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Replying, answering.
E.
उत्तर and दायक a giver.

f. (-दिक्)
The north quarter.
E.
उत्तर and दिश् region.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be done subsequently.
E.
उत्तर afterwards, धि to have, यत् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A demonstrated truth, a direct conclusion.
2 Course of argument, according to established truths.
3 Second part of an argument, reply, refutation.
4 The minor proposition in a syllogism.
E.
उत्तर subsequent, and पक्ष subject of an inference; also adding. क, उत्तरपक्षक.

f. (-ता)
1 Conclusion, demonstration.
2 Replication, reply.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, उत्तरपक्षत्व.

n. (-दं)
The last member of a compound word.
E.
उत्तर and पद word.

m. (-दः)
A division of legal practice, that part which relates to the reply or defence.
E.
उत्तर a reply, and पाद a quarter; four divisions being admitted in every suit.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to the last word or term.
E.
उत्तरपद and ठक् affix; also with छ added उत्तरपदकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं).

m. (-षः)
(In grammar,) The third person.
E.
उत्तर last, and पुरुष man.

m. (-दः)
A coverlid, a quilt.
E.
उत्तर and प्रच्छद what covers.

f. (-नी)
The twelfth lunar mansion containing two stars, figured by a bed.
E.
उत्तर subsequent, and फाल्गुनी or फल्गुनी an asterism; hence it also occurs उत्तरफल्गुनी.

f. (-द्)
The twenty-seventh lunar mansion, figured by a couch, and comprehending two stars, of which one is α Andromedae.
E.
उत्तर subsequent, and भाद्रपद properly the constellation; also with a final vowel, उत्तरभाद्रपद्रा.

n. (-त्रं)
Any reply, some reply.
E.
उत्तर and मात्र only.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unable to reply, having no answer.
E.
उत्तर and रहित devoid of.

n. (-णं)
The indication of an actual reply.
E.
उत्तर and लक्षण mark.

f. (-स्तिः)
A small syringe, a urethra injection pipe.
E.
उत्तर best, वस्ति syringe.

m. (-दी)
A defendant, a replicant. उत्तर a reply, and वादिन् who speaks.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Designated in the reply, (a witness, &c.)
E.
उत्तर and संज्ञित named.

m. (-क्षी)
Witness for the defence.
E.
उत्तर reply, and साक्षिन् a witness.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Befriending, assisting, a help, a friend.
2 Who or what establishes a reply.
E.
उत्तर and साधक what accomplishes.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Superior and inferior, higher and lower.
E.
उत्तर upper, अधर lower.

m. (-रः)
Right to property, &c. in succession to another person, heirship, inheritance.
E.
उत्तर and अधिकार right.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
An heir, a claimant, subsequent to the death, &c. of the original owner.
E.
उत्तराधिकार and इनि aff.

f. (-ता)
Right of succession.
E.
तल् added to उत्तराधिकारिन्; also with त्व, उत्तराधिकारित्व.

m. (-थः)
The north, a northern road or direction.
E.
उत्तर and पथिन् a road, the final of उत्तर lengthened.

m. (-सः)
A false, indirect, or prevaricating reply, (in law.)
E.
उत्तर a defence, and आभास what resembles: apparently a defence, but not so in fact.

f. (-ता)
Inadequacy of a reply, the semblance without the reality.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, उत्तराभासत्वं.

n. (-णं)
The period of the sun's progress to the north of the equator, the summer solstice.
E.
उत्तर the north, and अयन going, progress.

f. (-शा)
The north.
E.
उत्तर and आशा region.

f. (-ढा)
One of the lunar mansions, see उत्तराषाढा.

f. (-ढा)
The twenty-first of the lunar mansions, figured by an elephant's tooth or a bed, and containing two stars, one of which is β in Sagittarius.
E.
उत्तर subsequent, and आषाढा the constellation; to distinguish it from asterism twentieth: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and आषाढा.

m. (-तिः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
उत्तर, आशा a quarter, and पति a master; regent of the north.

m. (-ङ्गः)
An upper and outer garment.
E.
उत्तर upper, आङ् prefixed to षञ्ज to surround, and घञ् aff.

ind.
Northerly, from the north, implying distance.
E.
उत्तर and आहिच् aff.

n. (-यं)
An upper or outer garment.
E.
उत्तर upper, and छ aff.

ind.
Northward, posterior, subsequent.
E.
उत्तर with एनप् aff.

ind.
A subsequent day, a day following to-morrow.
E.
उत्तर subsequent, and एद्यस् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
More and more, further and further. &c.
n. (-रं)
1 A rejoinder, a reply to an answer.
2 Excess, exceeding quantity or degree.
3 Succession, gradation, descending.
E.
उत्तर repeated.

Shallow.
2

Sleeping supinely or with the face upwards.
3

Upright.
4

Concave.
E.
उत् upwards, तन to stretch, and घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A species of grass, (a cyperus): see उच्चटा.
E.
उत् much, तन to spread, वुज् aff.

m. (-दः)
1 A prince, son of SVAYAMBHU the

Manu.
2
One of the stars of the little bear, (β Ursi minoris.)

m. (-जः)
A name of DHRUVA.
E.
उत्तानपाद, ज born: the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
One who sleeps with the face upwards.
mf. (-यः-या)
An infant.
E.
उत्तान and शय who sleeps.

m. (-पः)
1 Great heat.
2 Affliction, distress.
3 Anxiety, excitement.
4 Effort, energy.
E.
उत् before तप to be hot, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Heated, made hot.
2 Pained, distressed.
3 Roused, excited.
E.
उत् before तप to be hot, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Unsteady, changing, shaking.
2 Sick.
E.
उत्, तृ to go, णिनि affix; or उत्तार and इनि aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be ejected, to be thrown up by vomiting.
E.
उत्, तृ to pass, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Best, excellent.
2 Arduous, difficult.
3

Formidable.
4

Swift, speedy.
5 Lofty, tall.
m. (-लः)
An ape.
E.
उत् before तल् to fix, affix घञ्.
